findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "util" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: parse_url · Private data: text_encode, hmac_sign_verify, validate_json, convert_data, parse_url, convert_time · Public sink: hash_text, hmac_sign_verify, geocode · Destructive: validate_identifier, parse_phone_number, cron_next_runs, make_qr_code, make_barcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: parse_url · Private data: text_encode, hmac_sign_verify, validate_json, convert_data, parse_url, convert_time · Public sink: hash_text, hmac_sign_verify, geocode · Destructive: validate_identifier, parse_phone_number, cron_next_runs, make_qr_code, make_barcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
